name: yt-dlp-video-link-extractor
title: yt-dlp Video Link Extractor - Any URL to Links, 1000+ Sites
description: Paste any video URL and get back direct stream/download links plus full metadata. Powered by yt-dlp across 1000+ sites. No files stored, no RAM burned.
seoTitle: yt-dlp Link Extractor - Any Video URL to Direct Links
seoDescription: Paste any video URL and get direct stream and download links plus metadata. yt-dlp on 1000+ sites: YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, Twitch, SoundCloud. Bulk lists.

overview.title: Links
overview.description: Direct link plus key metadata for each resolved video.

input_url.title: Input URL (input_url)
input_url.description: The URL you gave, as you entered it. A playlist gives one row per video, each with the playlist URL here.

ok.title: Resolved? (ok)
ok.description: True when the video resolved to its links; false when the URL failed, with the reason in error.

error.title: Why it failed (error)
error.description: The reason a URL could not be resolved, from yt-dlp or the site. Only on rows where ok is false.

extractor.title: Site (extractor)
extractor.description: The yt-dlp extractor that handled the URL, which names the site.

id.title: Video ID (id)
id.description: The video's ID on its site.

title.title: Video title (title)
title.example: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Video) (4K Remaster)

uploader.title: Channel name (uploader)
uploader.description: The channel or account that published the video.

channel_url.title: Channel link (channel_url)
channel_url.description: Link to the uploader's channel or profile page.

webpage_url.title: Source page (webpage_url)
webpage_url.description: The video's own page. For vimeo.com links it is the public player page the actor resolved.

duration.title: Length (duration)
duration.description: The video's length as H:MM:SS or M:SS.

view_count.title: Views (view_count)
view_count.description: How many times the video was viewed, when the site shows it.

like_count.title: Likes (like_count)
like_count.description: How many likes the video has, when the site shows it.

upload_date.title: Upload date (upload_date)
upload_date.description: The day the video was published, as YYYY-MM-DD.

is_live.title: Live stream? (is_live)
is_live.description: True for a live stream, which resolves to a stream manifest instead of a finished file.

thumbnail.title: Cover image (thumbnail)
thumbnail.description: Link to the video's main thumbnail image.

best_url.title: Direct link (best_url)
best_url.description: The best single link: a combined audio and video file when the site has one, otherwise the best video or audio stream.

best_url_kind.title: Link type (best_url_kind)
best_url_kind.description: What best_url holds: combined, video, audio or other.

best_url_protocol.title: Stream type (best_url_protocol)
best_url_protocol.description: How best_url streams: https for a plain file, m3u8 or dash for a stream manifest.

best_resolution.title: Quality (best_resolution)
best_resolution.description: The resolution of best_url, or audio only.

best_video_url.title: Best video link (best_video_url)
best_video_url.description: The highest-resolution video stream, often without audio on YouTube and Vimeo.

description.title: Video description (description)
description.example: The official video for Never Gonna Give You Up by Rick Astley.

formats.title: All formats (formats)
formats.description: Every format the site offers, each with its own direct link. Only when All formats is on.

format_id.title: Format ID (format_id)
format_id.description: The site's ID for this format.

ext.title: File type (ext)
ext.description: The file extension of this format.

vcodec.title: Video codec (vcodec)
vcodec.description: The video codec, or none for audio only.

acodec.title: Audio codec (acodec)
acodec.description: The audio codec, or none for video only.

filesize.title: File size in bytes (filesize)
filesize.description: The size in bytes, exact or estimated, when known.

tbr.title: Bitrate in kbps (tbr)
tbr.description: The total bitrate in kilobits per second.

note.title: Format note (note)
note.description: The site's label for the format, such as 360p or medium.

url.title: Direct link (url)
url.description: The direct link to this format.

thumbnails.title: All thumbnails (thumbnails)
thumbnails.description: Links to every thumbnail size. Only when All formats is on.

subtitles.title: Caption tracks (subtitles)
subtitles.description: Subtitle tracks by language, each with a file type and link. Only when Subtitles is on.

auto_captions.title: Auto captions (auto_captions)
auto_captions.description: Automatic caption tracks by language, same shape as subtitles. Only when Subtitles is on.
